description: Eastern Province - Amendment to the Rules and Regulations of Eastern Province Passenger Transport Authority Ordinance No. 2 of 2009
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the publication of rules and regulations for passenger transport services under the Eastern Province Passenger Transport Authority Ordinance No. 2 of 2009. It establishes legal frameworks, regulatory requirements, and compliance procedures for transport operations, including time table preparation, licensing, and enforcement mechanisms. While it mentions the Chief Minister's authority, the core content focuses on regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes or structural reorganization.
